rows.label: tlk70000061_04_msg0001
rows.name:
Since we came back to the capital,
Rita has visibly relaxed.

rows.label: tlk70000061_04_msg0002
rows.name:
Life in Gula was one tense moment
after another, so she must feel all
the more relieved now.

rows.label: tlk70000061_04_msg0003
rows.name:
Seeing Rita like that makes my desire
to protect her grow even stronger.

rows.label: tlk70000061_04_msg0004
rows.name:
It isn't a sense of duty as a Blade.
I find value in the life we share
right now.

rows.label: tlk70000061_04_msg0005
rows.name:
With such a scatterbrained Driver, I
may have a shorter life than other
Blades, but...

rows.label: tlk70000061_04_msg0006
rows.name:
I've even come to like that fate.
It feels like we're sharing a single
life, doesn't it?

rows.label: tlk70000061_04_msg0007
rows.name:
A short life can still be a happy one.
At least, that's what I think.
